subject: unexpected error with geom_boxplot + idendity stat + ALPHA

messages.author: 022a3b69b3216314
messages.subject: unexpected error with geom_boxplot + idendity stat + ALPHA
parts:
Hi,

I have this error and I can't explain why...

# reproducible example
df <- data.frame(single="a", min=-2, p25th=-1, median=0, p75th=1, max=2)

# this works
ggplot(data = df) +
  aes(x = single) +
  geom_boxplot(stat = 'identity'
               , aes(ymin = min, lower = p25th, middle = median, upper = p75th, ymax = max))

# that doesn't
ggplot(data = df) +
  aes(x = single) +
  geom_boxplot(stat = 'identity'
               , aes(ymin = min, lower = p25th, middle = median, upper = p75th, ymax = max)
               , alpha=I(0.5))


Any Idea?

François

messages.author: 0c39e60ddb38622b
messages.subject: Re: unexpected error with geom_boxplot + idendity stat + ALPHA
parts:
You don't need the identity wrapper I() in ggplot(); that's a qplot()
idiom for setting values of aesthetics. However, fixing that problem
reveals that alpha transparency operates on the box and whiskers, but
not on the median line. You can see this with

ggplot(data = df) +
aes(x = single) +
geom_boxplot(stat = 'identity'
, aes(ymin = min, lower = p25th, middle = median,
upper = p75th, ymax = max)
